summary: Monterey County peak near Bradley and Wunpost; the Fire Lookout index lists a Semas Mountain AWS there as gone, and no source describes the site today.

facts.status_note: The Fire Lookout index lists the AWS as gone; no source describes what remains at the summit

evidence.supports: near the hamlets of Bradley and Wunpost

notes_for_editor: Thin record. The index gives only type, county, coordinates and status; the Forest Lookouts page has no text beyond its title. The index types it AWS, so it may not be a fire lookout; the editor should decide whether it belongs in this set. Elevation is from Mapcarta. A peak datasheet snippet gives 1,219 ft, but that page returned 403 and was not read. The story uses no staffing, build or fate claims because no source gives them.
